notes: Original source SHA256 values identify historical input bytes. Published hashes identify the sanitized files actually distributed.
Embedded historical artifact digests remain provenance identifiers; omitted model coefficients invalidate full-artifact canonical hash replay. Use the published hashes and numeric replay command.
Legacy acquisition per-seed JSON/CSV, original legacy training checkpoints and original legacy multiseed diagnostic outputs were not recovered. Retained reports are explicitly identified.
The final manuscript and editable figure sources are included; manuscript-specific private revision notes and old backups are excluded.

camera-ready-v2 adds paper-specific independent rerun guides, a synthetic runner, and validated Stanford Waterbirds preparation. Missing historical run files limit exact archival replay, not the availability of experiment replication workflows.
